The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 09171 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 17 May - the folder's feast day. Captioned Andronik and Iuniya and filed by Commons under Category:Junia. The apostle of the Seventy and his fellow-worker are commemorated together on this day and this folder's own display name is «Andronicus, companion of Junia», so the joint plate is its hero. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
